entries.title: Psalms 129:1
segments: ¶<<A Song of degrees.>> Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth--oh let Israel say--

entries.title: Psalms 129:2
segments: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth; yet they have not prevailed against me.

entries.title: Psalms 129:3
segments: The ploughers ploughed upon my back; they made long their furrows.

entries.title: Psalms 129:4
segments: Jehovah is righteous: he hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.

entries.title: Psalms 129:5
segments: ¶Let them be ashamed and turned backward, all that hate Zion;

entries.title: Psalms 129:6
segments: Let them be as the grass upon the house-tops, which withereth before it is plucked up,

entries.title: Psalms 129:7
segments: Wherewith the mower filleth not his hand, nor he that bindeth sheaves his bosom;

entries.title: Psalms 129:8
segments: Neither do the passers-by say, The blessing of Jehovah be upon you; we bless you in the name of Jehovah!
